build_DeformableDETR_model: build a DeformableDETR model with backbone, transformer, num_classes, num_queries, and feature levels for object detection
run_DeformableDETR_forward: run the DeformableDETR forward pass on a NestedTensor of batched images to get prediction logits and boxes
build_SetCriterion: build a SetCriterion loss module with a matcher, weight dict, and loss types for training Deformable DETR
run_PostProcess: run PostProcess to convert model output logits and boxes into COCO API format with scores and labels
build_model_criterion_postprocessors: build the full DeformableDETR model, SetCriterion, and postprocessors from args including optional segmentation support
